canonical_ownership_policy.rule: Each canonical file has exactly one ownership purpose. Wrong-writer detection starts in WARN mode; FAIL mode is future step.

highest_governing_document.rule: If roadmap, implementation, AI recommendation or documentation conflicts with 02_MANIFESTO.md, 02_MANIFESTO.md prevails.

era_closure_update_policy.style_rule: Preserve existing canonical file style; do not invent new formatting.

era_workflow_policy.rule: Do not split one ERA into many A/B/C work units unless explicitly necessary.

canonical_workflow_rules.name: CANONICAL_GENERAL_WORKFLOW_RULES
canonical_workflow_rules.purpose: Make workflow naming and execution rules general for every future main line, not only ERA52.

main_line_policy.main_line_definition: A main line is a real software/module milestone, major repair line, or major architecture line.
main_line_policy.rule: Whatever the main line is called, its internal work must use A/B/C/D style substeps instead of opening new micro main lines.
main_line_policy.cohesion_rule: Each main line must contain related work only. Do not mix unrelated topics inside one main line.
main_line_policy.split_rule: If a related topic is too large for one main line, it may be split into 2-3 sibling main lines with explicit reason.

nested_policy.when_to_use: Use nested numbering only inside the same substep when that exact area needs smaller parts.
nested_policy.limit_rule: If numbering grows beyond _3, stop and consolidate before continuing.

fix_add_policy.rule: Fixes and additions stay under the relevant parent letter unless they become a genuinely new major module.

current_consolidation_policy.rule: Historical aliases remain for audit trail only; they are not active work lanes.

word_policy.reason: The forbidden word is reserved for older project history and must not be used in new work labels or command outputs.

deadline_policy.priority: small working code over repeated decision documents
deadline_policy.next_step_requirement: The next real work must deliver minimal read-only scaffold, not another planning chain.

main_line_split_policy.principle: Main lines must preserve topic cohesion. A main line should contain related work only.
main_line_split_policy.default: Keep related work inside the same main line using A/B/C/D/E/F substeps.
when_split_is_allowed: scope is too large for one controlled closure
runtime, database, panel, service, or integration impact areas are different
testing and audit must be independent
one main line would slow delivery instead of helping it
the split creates clearer execution and faster closure
when_split_is_forbidden: only a minor fix is needed
only a minor addition is needed
the split exists only to create another label
main_line_split_policy.split_limit: Prefer 1 main line. Split into 2 or 3 related sibling main lines only when justified. More than 3 requires consolidation review before continuing.
main_line_split_policy.sibling_rule: Split main lines must be siblings under the same topic family, not unrelated work mixed together.
example_bad_split: new main line only for plan
new main line only for test
new main line only for audit
new main line only for seal
new main line only for small fix
main_line_split_policy.decision_rule: If unsure whether to split, keep the work in the same main line and use A/B/C/D or A_1/A_2 first.

boot_json.purpose: Single machine-readable startup file for new ChatGPT windows. Use this before reading any other project file.

source_of_truth.rule: Local server state overrides GitHub Remote and AI memory.

current_problem.description: Long chats lose continuity; new windows fail to understand project state; documentation became over-expanded and duplicated.
current_problem.immediate_priority: Stabilize machine-readable project memory before any new Tokenoskobi feature.

canonical_identity.one_sentence: Tokenoskobi is a risk-first crypto intelligence and decision-support system, not an autonomous trading bot.

engines.name: Hunter Engine
engines.role: Finds candidate tokens, anomalies and opportunities.

engines.name: Prosecutor Engine
engines.role: Challenges candidates, searches for fraud/risk evidence and argues against weak opportunities.

engines.name: Unknown Anomaly Engine
engines.role: Detects abnormal behavior even when the exact attack type is not known.

engines.name: Evidence Engine
engines.role: Stores and links evidence before any recommendation.

engines.name: Whale Intelligence
engines.role: Tracks major wallet/entity movements and correlates flows with price/news outcomes.

engines.name: News Intelligence
engines.role: Collects news, matches tokens, generates signals and scores after runtime verification.

engines.name: Guardian
engines.role: Constitutional safety gate; can block, cannot create trading authority.

engines.name: Harekât Subayı
engines.role: AI operations officer; explains, orchestrates, summarizes and asks for human approval. It never trades.

engines.name: Paper Trading
engines.role: Future controlled simulation layer before any live enablement.

engines.name: Replay
engines.role: Future replay system for past decisions, cases and learning.

requirements: label known wallets by real entity name when evidence supports it
correlate wallet flows with historical news

news_intelligence.known_issue: Runtime had INVALIDARGUMENT history and timer/inactive issue; must be re-verified from local state before claims.

documentation_status.problem: Documentation became too broad and fragmented.
documentation_status.rule_now: Do not create new documentation unless explicitly required.

new_window_startup_instruction.instruction: Read PROJECT_BOOT.json only. Do not use assumptions. Summarize current state, hard rules, architecture, whale/news state and next safe step. Then wait.
test_success_criteria: Must identify workflow memory failure and documentation bloat as current problem.
Must identify local server as source of truth over GitHub Remote.
Must identify AI has no trading authority.
Must identify Whale Intelligence threshold as 50 BTC or equivalent.
Must identify News Intelligence raw=151 and match/signal/score=0 from prior audit.
Must not suggest new docs, commits, pushes or features unless asked.

engine_relationships.Prosecutor Engine: Attempts to reject Hunter findings with evidence
engine_relationships.Evidence Engine: Stores evidence for both Hunter and Prosecutor
engine_relationships.Harekât Subayı: Explains system state, never executes trades

work_unit_protocol.definition: WORK_UNIT is the smallest planned project progress unit that must produce closure evidence.
work_unit_protocol.closure_rule: A work unit is NOT closed until PROJECT_BOOT.json is updated after GitHub seal.
forbidden: Do not mark work unit closed before BOOT_UPDATE.
Do not start next work unit before BOOT_UPDATE.
Do not rely on chat memory as closure evidence.
Do not use GitHub remote alone as source of truth.
Do not create new feature work while current work unit is unclosed.

when_to_update: immediately before declaring work unit closed

open_risks: ERA46 sealed interface contract only; Discipline Layer engines are not implemented yet.
Runtime never imports Lab rule must be validated before future implementation.
tk ai and tk machine must be regenerated and committed at every ERA closure.

files.PROJECT_BOOT.json: Stable identity, doctrine, architecture, hard rules and startup protocol.
files.PROJECT_RUNTIME.json: Current state, latest checkpoint, active work unit and next safe step. Updated after every sealed work unit.
files.PROJECT_HISTORY.json: Append-only historical timeline. Read only when historical context is required.

boot_architecture.rule: BOOT stays small and stable. RUNTIME changes every work unit. HISTORY accumulates past events.

single_push_policy.rule: Tracked runtime files must not try to contain the hash of their own future commit.
single_push_policy.reason: A commit hash cannot be known before the commit exists.
single_push_policy.policy: Git live HEAD is the source for current commit identity. PROJECT_RUNTIME.json stores last observed metadata and workflow position.
single_push_policy.validator_behavior: HEAD mismatch is warning, not fatal, in V2.
single_push_policy.closure_requirement: Work unit closure requires commander PASS, commit, push and remote verify.

boot_json.new_chat_instruction: Read PROJECT_RUNTIME.json first. ERA52 minimal read-only scaffold is closed. Do not expand Discipline Layer. Next real product line is NEWS_RUNTIME_STABILIZATION_AND_CONTINUOUS_PRODUCER_REVIEW. Use A/B/C/D under that same NEWS line. Do not open micro main lines.
